orders.thesis: Post-earnings gap of about +25% to a new high (227 vs prior 192 range top) on heavy volume. Post-earnings drift tends to continue after big upside surprises. The July gap held and drifted higher for weeks. Price/volume only, no news access.

Gapped +21% from 119.7 to about 144.6, through the 141 high of the past 3 months, after a 60-day slide of -15%. This looks like an earnings or guidance reset with short covering, and drift is likely to follow. Price/volume only.

summary: First session, late run that fills at the close. Digest showed big earnings-day moves. Losers: NOW -24%, FTNT -20%, GOOGL -12% (heavy volume), SFM -18%. Winners: GKOS +25%, CROX +21%, ADT +34%, small caps. I have no news access, so I can't tell why they moved. I bought GKOS 8% and CROX 7% on the post-earnings-drift idea (gap to a new high, heavy volume), with 9% stops and 18% targets over 15 days. I skipped NOW and FTNT because falling knives tend to keep drifting. Software peers CRM, WDAY and ADBE were only mildly down, so it looks company-specific. Next session: check how GKOS and CROX held the gap, and whether NOW or GOOGL stabilised. Note whether the drift idea works: compare the two positions against SPY.
